posts.description: “I’ll do anything to bring her back! Anything, I swear!” Hiro yelled. “Anything?” She echoed as she devilishly licked her lips. Hiro was just a regular highschool boy. Every morning, he and his younger sister, Saki, walked to school together. Before leaving they always ate breakfast together.
